scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:relay
scripts.build:mobile:android: npm --prefix apps/mobile run build && npm --prefix apps/mobile exec -- cap sync android && ./apps/mobile/android/gradlew -p apps/mobile/android assembleDebug
